technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (MACD/PPO crossovers, three white soldiers) show bullish intent, but price remains below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud with mixed intermediate trend confirmation—moderate risk swing entry.

fundamental.summary: VRSK shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 27 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; modest congressional buying 110+ days ago lacks conviction; no recent news sentiment to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 27 days present binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum crossovers (MACD/PPO) and three white soldiers pattern signal bullish intent with price near support (173.261), offering a defined risk entry for swing traders in extreme fear conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels 312.3), price below all key moving averages (EMA/SMA 21/50) and Ichimoku cloud, high earnings risk in 27 days, zero fundamental conviction, and NFP volatility in 2 days make this a high-risk setup with unfavorable risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum crossovers (MACD/PPO) and three white soldiers offer defined-risk entry at support, but macro headwinds and earnings binary event in 27 days warrant observation rather than immediate entry.
